_comment: Judge-free labeled corpus for sizing the data-invariant classifier nodes. slackIntake entries deliberately AVOID pure greetings/thanks (those hit the deterministic fast-path in slackIntakeAgent.ts and never reach the model) — every entry here is a borderline case that exercises generateForNode. Template-safe: generic business metrics only, no client/table/project names. See scripts/universal-sweep.ts.

slackIntake.text: what kinds of questions can I ask you?
are you a real person or a bot?
show me revenue for last month
how many new users signed up yesterday?
what's our average order value this quarter?
compare conversion rates between mobile and desktop
why did churn spike in March?
good morning, can you pull last week's sales numbers?
trend of weekly active users over the past 90 days

thread.content: what was our total revenue last month?
Total revenue last month was $1.2M.

followUpClassifier.message: how many support tickets were opened last week?

thread.content: how many new users signed up in May?
There were 4,310 new signups in May.
what's our average order value this quarter?
Average order value this quarter is $84.20.
show me revenue by month for this year
Here is monthly revenue for the year so far.

followUpClassifier.message: can you break that down by region?

thread.content: who are our top 10 customers by spend?
Here are the top 10 customers by total spend.
how many signups did we get last month?
There were 4,310 signups last month.

followUpClassifier.message: filter that to just paid plans

thread.content: what was revenue last quarter?
Revenue last quarter was $3.4M, based on the orders data.

followUpClassifier.message: why did you use the orders table for that?

thread.content: what's our churn rate this month?
Churn rate this month is 3.1%.

followUpClassifier.message: how did you calculate that number?

thread.content: what's our gross margin?
Gross margin is 62%.

followUpClassifier.message: which tables did you query to get this?

thread.content: how is revenue trending this year?
Revenue is up 18% year over year.

followUpClassifier.message: if revenue is up, why is profit down?

thread.content: how is website traffic doing?
Traffic grew 25% over the past quarter.

followUpClassifier.message: if traffic grew, how come signups fell?

thread.content: how many orders did we process last month?
We processed 12,400 orders last month, up from 11,000.

followUpClassifier.message: orders went up but revenue dropped — what's going on?
